died.name: Edward Coke
died.last_words: Thy kingdom come, thy will be done.

died.name: Oliver Cromwell
died.desc: English general and statesman, Lord Protector
died.last_words: It is not my design to drink or to sleep, but my design is to make what haste I can to be gone.

died.name: Alonso Cano
died.cause: asking a priest to take away a badly carved crucifix
died.last_words: Vex me not with this thing, but give me a simple cross, that I may adore it, both as it is in itself and as I can figure it in my mind.

died.name: Marie Thérèse Louise of Savoy, Princesse de Lamballe
died.cause: upon seeing bloody corpses in the courtyard where she was then murdered

died.name: Zhang Zongchang
died.cause: Chinese warlord, after being shot by an assassin

died.name: E. E. Cummings
died.cause: to his wife, who was worried it was too hot for him to be chopping wood; he then suffered a stroke
died.last_words: I'm going to stop now, but I'm going to sharpen the ax before I put it up, dear.
